steps.observation: Work on this for 900 seconds; do not stop early. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
Here are three major causes of World War I:

1. Militarism  
   European powers engaged in an arms race, massively expanding armies and navies. This build-up made nations more willing to resort to military solutions and created a hair-trigger readiness for war.

2. Alliance System  
   Two rival blocs formed: the Triple Alliance (Germany, Austria-Hungary, Italy) and the Triple Entente (France, Russia, Britain). A conflict involving one member could—and did—draw in all the others.

3. Imperialism  
   Competition for overseas colonies and resources heightened tensions, especially among Germany, Britain, and France. Disputes over territories in Africa and Asia fostered mistrust and rivalry.
